question: Will Brentford beat, draw with, or lose to Tottenham Hotspur? (Premier League, Aug 22, 2026)

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if Brentford's official final score is strictly greater than Tottenham Hotspur's official final score at the end of the match (including any added time; excluding extra time and penalty shootouts unless the competition rules declare the result on that basis).
- "No": Wins if Tottenham Hotspur's official final score is strictly greater than Brentford's official final score at the end of the match (including any added time; excluding extra time and penalty shootouts unless the competition rules declare the result on that basis).
- "Draw": Wins if both teams' official final scores are equal at the end of the match (including any added time; excluding extra time and penalty shootouts unless the competition rules declare the result on that basis).
